nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway... Thanks, guys! Good luck tonight!
Paige leaves. Owen and Ben reach the bus and climb aboard.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Nice of you to join us!
The guys find a seat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: See what I mean about something being up with Paige?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't even need to say anything. She's getting `our` advice for a party? It's weird enough to see her smiling so much, let alone actually `caring` about other people.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't even need to say anything. She's getting [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] advice for a party? It's weird enough to see her smiling so much, let alone actually [color=#e23b3b][i]caring[/i][/color] about other people.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, you were saying something about her before she showed up.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I was just going to give you some advice...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: There's no reason for stuff with her to affect how you play basketball. You just have to separate the two.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't you think that's a little hypocritical of you to say?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I mean Emily totally affects how you play... Why can't Paige affect how I play?
Ben sits there, feeling foolish, as the bus lurches forward and drives off in the direction of Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course it does! I'm really good at it too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem. I'm not so sure the 'poor' people are going to like you guessing how much their clothes cost.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. It's settled.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: How so?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: People who don't have much money aren't going to want you calling them out on it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can't relate, but you might have a point.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess you'll have to think of another game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We've gotta go!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean about it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, but no one's going to want you telling them how much you think their purse cost!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because not everyone spends more than three hundred dollars on a purse!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha! Funny joke! Like you can even find a purse for under five!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It sounds...?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's just say I don't have the words for it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That just leaves the entertainment. Not that I need your help or anything since I already have the `best` party game in mind.
nodes.text_bbcode: That just leaves the entertainment. Not that I need your help or anything since I already have the [color=#3b78e2][i]best[/i][/color] party game in mind.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do I want to know?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's called Guess How Much! You try to guess how much everyone's clothes and purses cost! My friends and I play all the time!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That game idea sounds...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wouldn't that just cater to guys?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It doesn't have to. There's the cheerleading team, the girls basketball team, the girls swim team.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All the athletes could wear their uniforms! The whole thing would be like one big pep rally!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: One last hurrah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Or not.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I... I love it! I'll do it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? I'm trying to throw a party for poor people, and your idea is to theme it around money?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, it might not be my best--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I love it! I'm totally going to do it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What better way to encourage other people to work harder than to show them what hard work can `earn?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What better way to encourage other people to work harder than to show them what hard work can [color=#3b78e2][i]earn?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, 'cause you earned it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Around what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I dunno... Money?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That covers snacks. What about a theme to decorate around?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you really need a theme?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you really need a face?! Of course the party needs a theme!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, what happened to nice Paige?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh yeah... I meant, uh... Great question, Ben! Sometimes we have to question the obvious!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, why don't you theme it around...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You guys like chips and salsa?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's not to like? Crispy tortilla chips, diced tomatoes, onions, and peppers. So much spicy goodness!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Plus, you get to eat with your hands!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hands? Ew. I might throw up now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Although... Maybe I could use a caviar spoon for the salsa and my diamond-studded tongs for the chips.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, I take back all my previous 'wow's' and put them here. I didn't know diamond-studded tongs were coming.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Does this meet her royal Highness's needs?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes. Although I'd appreciate less attitude from my subjects.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Pigs in a blanket? I... I guess I could do that. You sure eat some disgusting things.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Cause eating the eggs of a fish is a totally pleasant idea.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, at least I don't serve those eggs in a heated aquarium!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry... I didn't mean to get snappy. What I meant to say was, um, of course I'll serve whatever barbaric-sounding delicacies you want!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to go. I hope you find your mother's brooch.
Emily leaves, and Ben lets her go.
You are now playing as Owen.
It's the day of the basketball game. As class lets out, Owen heads down the hall toward the parking lot where the team's bus is waiting.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Owen! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey... Man, I never thought that class would end.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Mr. Russell really knows how to put the please-end-my-life-I'm-going-to-die-of-boredom into physics.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You ready for the game tonight?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I actually wanted to talk to you about, you know, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I was thinking maybe you could just--
Paige suddenly appears next to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ben! Were you and Owen just talking about me?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! I mean, er--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's nothing to fret over! There's no reason to be tense... Especially not before an important game! Do you need anything from me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A massage? A beverage? A massaging beverage? I don't know if those exist, but they should!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Is... Is she for real?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I told you she was acting weird!
A frown flashes across Paige's lips. For an instant, she looks hopelessly sad. Then she forces a smile.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Weird? What are you talking about, Owen? Is it weird to finally realize that we should treasure every second with our friends? There are so many things we take for granted.
Ben mutters under his breath.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where did Paige go?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you talking about, Paige? Does this have something to do with that big talk you told me you were having with your mom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `That` is not important. What's important is celebrating!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] is not important. What's important is celebrating!

nodes.text: Ben whispers to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How long before the real Paige shows up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey! You don't get to keep secrets from me, Owen! `I` keep secrets from you, got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey! You don't get to keep secrets from me, Owen! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] keep secrets from you, got it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, that didn't take long.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, I mean... Excuse me. I don't know what came over me. Don't you two gentlemen have a bus to attend to? I can escort you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I say for the record that you're really weirding me out?
They exit the school doors into the parking lot. Coach is standing near the bus.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hurry up, ladies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We've gotta go, Paige. See you at the game?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait! I need your help. I'm throwing an after-party and--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No way! The last `party` of yours I went to was a trap! My kind of parties involve lots of people who are `our` age!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! The last [color=#e23b3b][i]party[/i][/color] of yours I went to was a trap! My kind of parties involve lots of people who are [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] age!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did you go to a baby party?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I swear this won't be like that! My mom's out of town with Tad! They're not going to be back for another week!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, what do you need our help for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to throw...
Paige has trouble getting the words out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to throw a party that you guys would enjoy. A... A poor people party.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So nice when you put it like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Can you help me or not? I know enough not to serve beluga caviar. But which eggs does your kind prefer? Ossetra? Just don't tell me you eat Stevruga. I'm not ready to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know, right? I'm `even` thinking about a flexible dress code that permits casual evening gowns and laid-back tuxedos.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, right? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]even[/i][/color] thinking about a flexible dress code that permits casual evening gowns and laid-back tuxedos.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I take back my previous 'wow' and insert it here?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: As much fun as it'd be to watch you attempt this party on your own, we'll help you. But make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, We don't want to have to chase after the bus again, and Coach is starting to get that impatient look in his eye.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay! Okay! If you guys don't want caviar, what kind of hors d'oeuvres should I serve?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You should definitely serve...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! What could I possibly be jealous of?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're jealous because all of a sudden your dad cares more about me than he ever did for you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I can't believe you said that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, go ahead! Say what you were going to say!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think it would be better for both of us if I kept my mouth shut instead...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fine...
Ben doesn't say anything.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And you know what that means, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If you say something about my dad, I swear...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's like the whole point, Emily. If we win Sectionals, you and I will be able to spend so much time together without any hassle from your father.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Grr! This isn't about `us,` Ben! Maybe it was before, but it's not about us anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! This isn't about [color=#3b78e2][i]us,[/i][/color] Ben! Maybe it was before, but it's not about us anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Look! We're hanging out together `right` now! I don't see my dad anywhere. Do you? It's not like he's nearly as strict with me as he used to be!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look! We're hanging out together [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] now! I don't see my dad anywhere. Do you? It's not like he's nearly as strict with me as he used to be!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: This is about `your` dad, Ben. It's pretty obvious, so let's just get it out in the open.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is about [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] dad, Ben. It's pretty obvious, so let's just get it out in the open.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? This has nothing to do with my dad, okay?! You're just...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... You're only happy because I'll help you win?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Well, it's true.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm not sacrificing my schedule to make you play better, you know. I'm coming to support you. To be there for you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know. I know. But it `does` increase our odds of winning.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know. I know. But it [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] increase our odds of winning.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What moves are those?
Ben does a quick spin move, circling around Emily.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... The moves of `attraction.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I don't know... The moves of [color=#e23b3b][i]attraction.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hee hee! Okay, that was kind of slick. For you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: With me trying to impress you, we'll win for sure.
Owen walks off toward the locker room.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Owen plays how he did today against Wilson High, it doesn't matter how many points everyone else scores, we'll still lose!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know it's up to me now to help him... But how?
That night, Ben and Emily are at Ben's house, rummaging through a dusty, unused dining room. Boxes are piled up everywhere.
Elsewhere, the house is perfectly quiet. No one else is home. Ben's father is away on business... Again.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: At least you tried to do something. That seems pretty captain-like to me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm telling you I missed an opportunity to help Owen. Someone better than me would have known what to say.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You're being too hard on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Am I? We lost in practice because of him. If I don't help Owen, I'm pretty sure we're going to lose against Wilson High too!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe you should just talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Besides, would losing be the end of the world?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yes! Your dad would go back to thinking I'm Ben the Slacker, bent on corrupting his daughter.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Right... `My` dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... [color=#3b78e2][i]My[/i][/color] dad.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Forget it. What is it we're trying to find again?
Emily lifts up a stack of boxes.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My mom's brooch. She probably just lost it. When she called me this morning, she accused my dad of 'selling it before the ink dried on the divorce papers'.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry things are so messy between your parents.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was never all that 'clean'.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: If it makes you feel better, I have good news to share with you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Did you buy me a brooch for Valentine's Day?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No. You're not special enough for jewelry. But I `am` coming to your game.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. You're not special enough for jewelry. But I [color=#3b78e2][i]am[/i][/color] coming to your game.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you serious?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do I swim the 50m backstroke in under 32 seconds?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You totally do!
Ben does a little jig, then stops abruptly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... How did you find the time?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I had a talk with my dad. I promised him some extra swim sessions over the weekend. He couldn't say no to that.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You weren't kidding about it being good news!
Emily notices a box with the top slightly open.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's this?
She opens it. Inside are a collection of odds and ends... Photographs, a school ribbon for science achievement, and a folded piece of paper.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh...
Emily unfolds the paper.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: 'To Dad. The owner of this coupon is entitled to ten free hugs from your son, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: ...Happy Father's Day!'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, this is the cutest thing I've ever seen! It even has a drawing of you two hugging!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, it's really cute. Let's, um, let's just look for my mom's brooch.
Ben takes the paper from Emily and stuffs it into his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So... I can't even begin to tell you how excited I am that you're coming to my game!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And why's that?

options.label: It gives me a chance to show off my moves!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uhh...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What, Ben?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's... A great player? Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: A great player?! What game were you watching?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: If he's a great player, I should play professionally!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You don't know what you're saying, Kale!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. Thanks for your help, Ben. Maybe you could help set up another round of insults.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I was trying to be honest.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, well, they're right. I'm not a great player.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the next time you want to be honest, try saying something closer to the truth.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm no good for this team right now...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Did you just say 'best `looking`'?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you just say 'best [color=#e23b3b][i]looking[/i][/color]'?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale, have you lost your mind?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What are you saying, Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, um... Look at him! He's got a, um, a great smile!
The guys stop for a second and look at Owen.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know one thing for sure, he looks better than me!
The guys laugh.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: At least they're not ragging on Owen anymore...
As they continue laughing...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! Get out here!
Ben and Owen sprint out onto the court and get into position.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Since we don't have enough players to scrimmage against ourselves, I enlisted some of the players from the girls' team to help us out!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Great. I needed a confidence boost!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'd need one too if I lost the way you guys did to Willow Glen!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Grr!
Coach blows his whistle, and the scrimmage starts!
Over the next few plays, Ben does outstanding. He makes easy shots, smart passes, and plays tough defense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I hope I can play like this against Wilson High!
Unfortunately, things don't go nearly as well for Owen. Early on, Owen guards Jane by mistake!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm open!
Jane passes the ball to a wide-open Kim, and she makes a three-pointer!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What are you doing?! Jane isn't your man! Kim is!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey! Who are you calling a man?!
And later...
After Kim's shot clangs off the rim, Megan steps in front of Owen, grabs the rebound, and puts the ball in!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude! How could you let her do that?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know... I just forgot to box out.
Near the end of the practice scrimmage, the guys set up one final play trailing by one point...
Jacob dribbles the ball down and passes it to Owen... But it slips through his fingers and right into Jane's hands!
Coach blows his whistle. The scrimmage is over.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Who's a man now, losers?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I mean... You know what I mean!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: They do! You mean we crushed them like metal in a compactor!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Awww, it's okay, boys. You came close. Just not close enough! Ha ha!
The girls walk away.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I played so well... And we lost... I can't believe we lost.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It isn't hard to believe! Owen here gave them the game!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Seriously! You need to wake up, Owen!
For one brief moment, Ben feels like there's something he can say... Some way to come to Owen's defense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Listen, guys... Uh...
But he doesn't know what it is, so instead he says...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let her act weird for a while. Sooner or later, you'll see an opportunity when she'll want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You think so?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trust me. Emily gets into funks sometimes. But eventually, she always let me know what's going on.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right. I think I can do that. I just don't like the idea of waiting...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, no one does.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your whole relationship, or whatever it is, seems to be you two acting like jerks to each other.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I think that's oversimplifying things.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whatever. Sometimes things are simple. If she tries to change the subject, don't let her. Make her talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I'm not going to do that. It sounds `way` too aggressive.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, I'm not going to do that. It sounds [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] too aggressive.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Fine. Don't listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I won't.

nodes.speaker: Ben
